treachery: You turned your blade on those who stood beside you.
Your cohort trusted you. The Spell saw what you did with that trust.
protector: Again and again, you stepped between the dark and the others.
Those who walked with you are alive because of you.
reckless: You danced at the edge of death as if it were a game.
Courage and recklessness wear the same mask. You wore it often.
defiant: You raised your hand against things far above you, and they fell.
Your rank did not stop you. It rarely does, for long.
merciful: You took no lives in this Nightmare.
Not one creature fell by your hand. Whether that was mercy or fear, the Spell does not say.
alone: You entered alone, and alone you left.
No one shared this Nightmare with you.
